visualCharacteristics.purpose: Grid of article teaser cards (case studies, blog posts)
description: 3-up bordered article cards, image top, clamped title/description, optional date, arrow link

contentPattern.structure: cell 1: image; cell 2: title paragraph linked to the article, description paragraph, optional date paragraph (e.g. "October 21, 2026"). The whole card is clickable via the title link and gets a decorative arrow
notes: Same repeating article-card structure as the case studies, plus a publish date.

usage: Use for a 3-up list of case studies or blog posts linking to full articles.
reuseGuidance: Reuse wherever repeating image/title/description/link article teasers appear, with or without a date.
